game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round, frost imps strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the guards value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from frost imps in Ice Mill: keep the guards meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: guards drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Guards' (Week 6 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ice Mill'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while guards > 0.
